widget.name: CalaSign
widget.short_description: Send for signature from a lead with CalaSign
widget.description: Electronic signatures with CalaSign from Kommo: send a contract from a lead with its contacts and data, and get the envelope status, the signed PDF and a note with the hash back on the lead. Connect Kommo in CalaSign → Settings → CRM and ERP.

settings.note: Note (optional). The connection is made in CalaSign → Settings → CRM and ERP → Kommo.
